=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven empowered-state reference
for Riven.

Keep the same woman,
appearance,
hair,
clothing,
armor,
injuries,
and exhausted physical condition.

At the beginning,
Riven is still holding
the fully activated emerald-green empowered weapon.

Use the provided empowered weapon reference
for its active appearance.

The emerald energy will gradually fade
during this video.

After the energy completely disappears,
the weapon returns to its normal physical state.

Preserve the same physical weapon underneath.
Do not create a different sword.


Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the environment.

Use the provided battlefield image
as an additional environment reference.

Match the broad dirt road,
burning wooden buildings,
heavy smoke,
orange firelight,
distant mountains,
and overall atmosphere.

The supernatural darkness is completely gone.

Only normal fire,
smoke,
ash,
embers,
and mountain wind remain.


=== STARTING STATE ===

The battle is already over.

Riven stands alone
on the burning village road.

She is badly exhausted
and breathing heavily.

Her empowered emerald weapon
is still active in her hands.

There is no enemy.

There is no supernatural darkness.

Nothing attacks her.

The settlement is damaged and burning,
but the atmosphere has become quiet.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Quiet emotional aftermath.

Natural restrained performances.

Slow,
controlled cinematic camera movement.

No combat.

No heroic posing.

No celebration.

No melodramatic acting.

Natural fire,
wind,
crackling wood,
distant movement,
soft footsteps,
and breathing.

No background music.

No subtitles.

No title.

No text on screen.

Dialogue in English.

Keep the scene emotionally restrained.

Use THREE major cinematic phases.


=== PHASE 1 — AFTER THE BATTLE ===

OPEN on a close cinematic view
of Riven's hand
holding the empowered weapon.

The emerald blade
is still glowing brightly.

Riven's hand is tired
and slightly trembling
from exhaustion.


The supernatural wind
around the weapon begins to weaken.


The emerald energy
slowly fades.


The large translucent green energy
surrounding the physical weapon
begins dissolving
into small fading particles.


The glowing runes
gradually become dimmer.


The green energy disappears completely.


Only Riven's normal physical weapon remains.


No magical energy remains
on the weapon.


Reveal Riven standing
on the burning road.


She lowers the weapon
toward her side.


She is exhausted.


Her shoulders relax slightly.


She looks toward
the empty battlefield.


The enemy is gone.


For the first time,

there is no immediate danger.


Riven quietly catches her breath.


Around her,

normal smoke drifts
between the burning buildings.


Ash falls slowly.


The settlement is still damaged,

but the strange supernatural darkness
is completely gone.


=== PHASE 2 — THE SURVIVORS ===

Riven begins hearing
quiet human movement
behind her.


She turns.


A small number
of surviving villagers
slowly emerge
from between the damaged buildings
and safer hiding places.


Some are injured.


Some support each other
as they walk.


Others quietly look
at the burning remains
of their homes.


Nobody celebrates.


Nobody cheers for Riven.


They are simply relieved
to still be alive.


Riven watches them silently.


Among the survivors
is a young girl,
around eight to ten years old.


The girl notices Riven.


She looks at the exhausted woman
standing alone
with the damaged weapon
lowered beside her.


The girl hesitates.


Then she slowly walks
toward Riven.


Riven notices her approaching.


Riven lowers the weapon further
and keeps it relaxed beside her.


The girl stops
a short distance in front of Riven.


She looks briefly
at Riven's weapon.


Then she looks up
at Riven's face.


A quiet moment.


The girl asks softly:


"Are you a warrior?"


=== PHASE 3 — THE ONE WHO STAYED ===

Riven does not answer immediately.


She looks down
at the weapon in her hand.


The emerald power is gone.


Only the physical weapon remains.


Riven quietly studies it
for a moment.


Then she looks past the girl.


Behind her,

the surviving villagers
are helping one another.


One person supports
someone who is injured.


Others slowly gather together
among the damaged buildings.


They are alive.


Riven looks back
at the young girl.


Her expression is tired
and calm.


No smile.


No pride.


No heroic expression.


Riven answers quietly:


"No..."


A brief natural pause.


Then:


"I'm just the one who stayed."


The girl quietly looks at Riven.


She does not reply.


Hold the silence
for a brief moment.


The girl turns
toward the other survivors.


Riven looks in the same direction.


Riven does not walk away.


She remains there.


Transition naturally
into a wider final view.


Riven and the young girl
remain among the survivors.


The villagers quietly
help one another
through the aftermath.


Riven is no longer standing
separately from everyone else.


She remains with them.


The burning settlement
stretches behind the survivors.


Normal smoke rises
into the mountain air.


The fires continue burning,

but the supernatural darkness
is gone.


No green magical energy remains.


No enemy returns.


No one celebrates.


Riven simply stays.


Hold the final image.


CUT TO BLACK.


=== FINAL STATE ===

The battle is completely over.

The Mysterious Dark Figure
does not appear.

There is no further combat.

Riven's emerald empowered state
has completely faded.

Her weapon has returned
to its normal physical state.

Riven remains exhausted
but standing.

The young girl
and a small number of survivors
are present.

Riven does not leave the settlement.

She remains with the survivors.

No title.

No text.

No additional dialogue.

CUT TO BLACK.
